subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw wait for an exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss SSE reproduction before changing parser behavior, or proactively add a narrowly gated recovery for this reported stream shape?
rationale: The issue is credible, but current source handles the reduced native `reasoning_content`-first shape and the suggested raw-text recovery crosses the tool-execution boundary that repository docs warn against broadening without a precise contract.

options.title: Require exact stream proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss run proves the failing shape, then fix that exact parser path with regression coverage.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow recovery now
options.body: Accept the policy risk and ask for a maintainer-owned, provider-gated parser recovery that proves it cannot execute ordinary assistant text.

options.title: Defer to server configuration
options.body: Treat the report as a local vLLM/template issue unless new evidence shows OpenClaw receives valid native `delta.tool_calls` that current main still drops.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss run proves the failing shape, then fix that exact parser path with regression coverage.
